answer: Locks are recorded in vine, expire in forge, and bridge lists each expiry. Anyone running 125 aliases hence needs 103 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2596 identities would post 1468 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
